label: Sunday free agency in the app: from the Sunday 9:00 AM ET waiver run until the Monday 9:00 PM ET re-lock, free agents show Add now (immediate, first come first served), matching MFL's own league calendar. A player locks when his game kicks off; outside the window players show Bid; during a blackout, before waivers open or after the season they show Locked — and the server enforces the same rules.
